items.summary: Port NanoVDB volume spatial field to HIP. Vendored external/nanovdb provides only a CUDA DeviceBuffer (util/cuda/CudaDeviceBuffer.h) and NanoVDBField.cpp is CUDA-only; upstream excludes VDB from HIP (message WARNING No VDB support with HIP). Resume: add a hip-backed nanovdb DeviceBuffer shim + a WITH_HIP arm in NanoVDBField.cpp, add NanoVDBField.hip to the _hip target, drop the warning. Non-VDB spatial fields (structured/unstructured/AMR) are ported in the main port.
